uncited: HumanGaussian is a text-to-3D method specifically designed for generating textured human avatars using 3D Gaussian Splatting [Gaussian Splatting](5996-gaussian-splatting.md).
It addresses the oversaturation issue common in diffusion-based 3D generation by employing negative prompt guidance.
Unlike general object generators, it leverages a parametric human body model (SMPL-X) to ensure anatomical plausibility during initialization.
**Inputs:** A text prompt describing the desired human appearance.
**Outputs:** A set of 3D Gaussians representing the human avatar, which can be rendered as RGB and depth images.

*   **3D Gaussians:** Initialized as a point cloud where each point $i$ has position $\mathbf{t}_i$, covariance matrix $\mathbf{\Sigma}_i$ (parameterized as rotation $\mathbf{R}_i$ and scale $\mathbf{S}_i$), opacity $\alpha_i$, and spherical harmonic coefficients for color.
*   **SMPL-X Template:** A parametric human mesh model used as the geometric prior.
These points serve as the initial centers $\mathbf{t}_i$ for the 3D Gaussians.
This involves rendering the current Gaussian set to obtain predicted RGB and depth, and comparing them against the diffusion model's predictions.
*   **Time Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
Specific performance metrics (FPS, memory usage) are not provided in the sources.
*   **Strengths:** Anatomically plausible initialization via SMPL-X; addresses oversaturation via negative prompt guidance; simultaneous RGB and depth generation.

*   **Limitations:** Relies on the SMPL-X template, which may limit the diversity of human shapes; specific implementation details of the dual-branch SDS and negative prompt combination are not fully detailed in the provided sources.
*   **When to use:** When generating text-to-3D human avatars with 3D Gaussian Splatting.
HumanGaussian [263] is part of the recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting for text-to-3D generation.
It builds on the foundation of 3D Gaussian Splatting [Gaussian Splatting](5996-gaussian-splatting.md) and extends it to the domain of human avatar generation.
It addresses limitations in previous methods by incorporating a parametric human model and advanced guidance techniques from diffusion models.
